adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration builds raw SQL with string interpolation: `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, ...)"` where `h` comes from the stored `site_settings` value split by newlines. If any stored host line contains a single quote (or other SQL-significant characters), the generated SQL becomes invalid and can break the migration (and also creates SQL injection risk in a migration context).
